channel.title: Yasir Hassan · Writeups
channel.description: Notes on security, cryptography and the systems Yasir Hassan builds.

item.title: Building a tamper-evident land registry
item.description: How Milkiyat uses hash chaining, AES-256-GCM and RSA signatures so that any edit to a land record, even one made directly in the database, is caught.

item.title: Training a fire and smoke detector for multi-camera surveillance
item.description: Notes from building the detection layer of VigiLense, my final year project: training YOLO on D-Fire, reading the metrics honestly, and turning detections into alerts people can act on.
